## CMsoft Import for Melsec

GX Works3 objects imported into `MelsecImport/Projects/<project>/` as PLCopen XML (POUs, global labels, structured
data types). Full instructions, applied automatically:

- [instructions/melsec-import.instructions.md](instructions/melsec-import.instructions.md) — import / export
  terminology, the connect → import → edit → export → build workflow, the `melsec_*` tools and the rules;
- [instructions/melsec-import-cli.instructions.md](instructions/melsec-import-cli.instructions.md) — the CLI
  bridge (for scripts in `Tools/`).
